title: Connection Frame Color has no effect in 1.78.2 NB 3782
author: igor2x
body_snippet: I am testing latest NB 3782 release on Windows 11: 1. Click on connection. 2. Display | Connection Frame Color and select _Red (Production)_. 3. Double click on connection and new connection tab is opened. The issue appears. I expect frame to be in red color, but it stays in blue.
